decision: Bound completion to one shared Vitest config, per-project thresholds, red and green proof, CI inclusion, clean reports, and cache stability
why: The brief defines a CI gate with high blast radius

decision: Chose one root Vitest config with Moon passing each project root
why: One source of truth keeps projects isolated without per-member config

decision: Set statements 80, branches 75, functions 80, and lines 80
why: The floor catches untested files while leaving room for defensive paths; 100 would reward execution without useful assertions

decision: Added behavior tests for the web bootstrap and the application template
why: The first coverage run found main.tsx at zero; excluding it would hide untested code and generated apps would fail
result: wrong selector failed, valid bootstrap passed

decision: Proved all four thresholds with a temporary uncovered function, then covered both branches
why: The gate needed direct red and green evidence

decision: Rebuilt coverage outputs after the deliberate cache-off run left stale files under a matching task hash
why: Moon skips hydration when matching outputs already exist, so the proof state had to be made current before cache checks

decision: Generated one library and one application and ran their inherited coverage tasks
why: The baseline generator must not create members that fail the new gate
result: both generated members passed at 100 percent

decision: Ran both build tasks before and after both coverage tasks
why: Coverage artifacts must not invalidate unrelated build tasks

decision: Ran just check, compared status across moon check --all, and ran just ci
why: The repository contract requires both local repair and read only CI proof
result: all gates passed and status matched
